articles.title: Entertainment leaders amp up discussions about AI, creators and innovative tech at CES 2026
articles.mainIdea: Entertainment leaders amp up discussions about AI, creators and innovative tech at CES 2026
articles.summary: Associated Press Finance: Entertainment leaders amp up discussions about AI, creators and innovative tech at CES 2026. More than 25 different panels and events related to the entertainment industry are on the schedule in Las Vegas, focusing on both the traditional studio side of the industry and the digital side driven by content creators. The programming has posed questions about the cinematic capabilities of AI, how advertising has been impacted by AI and the role the burgeoning creator economy plays in the larger entertainment landscape. Artificial intelligence has long been a sticking point in Hollywood, and many creatives in the entertainment world have been reluctant to embrace the rapidly evolving technology and AI-powered tools.
